members.title: Members at report time
members.description: One row per member of each folder set at report time, not as at the end of the period: whether they keep access, through what, who proposed, added or changed their access and why.

columns.description: The folder set the row belongs to.
The folders in the folder set.
The person's name.
The person's email address.
The person's job title from the directory.
The person's department from the directory.
Account type from the directory, such as Member or Guest.
What the person can do, such as Read or Edit.
The groups that give the person access.
Whether the person also has access in their own name, not only through a group.
Whether the person keeps access after the review.
Whether the person is the folder set's data owner.
Polar Sky, or the person who added or changed this access.
When that was done.
The last change recorded for this person, such as added.
Why the person has access.
Who approved the folder set's access.
When the folder set's access was approved.
When the members list was read.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: One row per group kept or dropped on each folder set, and per group the live read found granting access that was not decided in Polar Sky.

columns.description: The folder set the row belongs to.
The folders in the folder set.
The group's name.
The group's email address.
Whether the group was kept, dropped or found only in the live read.
What the group's members can do, such as Read or Edit.
How many people are in the group.
Whether every member of a kept group is listed.
People outside your directory who get access through the group.
Who approved the folder set's access.
When the folder set's access was approved.

shares.title: Kept direct shares
shares.description: One row per direct share kept on each folder set, read when the report was generated.

columns.description: The folder set the row belongs to.
The person the item is shared with.
That person's email address.
Whether the shared item is a file or a folder.
The shared file or folder.
What the person can do, such as Read or Edit.
When the share was read.

removals.title: Removals
removals.description: One row per change Polar Sky applied, or tried to apply, that took access away or lowered it in the period. Removals Polar Sky recorded also have the decision date and the deadline check.

columns.description: The folder set the change belongs to.
The folders in the folder set.
The kind of change, such as removing or lowering access.
The change in words.
The kind of thing the change acted on, such as a folder, group or link.
What the change acted on, such as a folder or a group.
The person or group that lost or had lowered access.
The permission removed or lowered, such as Edit to Read.
For a link, who could open it, such as anyone with the link.
The result, such as Removed, Lowered, Failed, Pending or Not applied.
When the change reached that result.
Why a change failed or was not applied.
When a later read confirmed the access was gone.
When the removal was decided.
Whether the change was made within the removal deadline.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.description: One row per approval of a folder set's access in the period, plus any approval from before the period that was still in force when it began, with when and how an approval ended in the period.

columns.description: The folder set that was approved.
The folders in the folder set.
Who approved.
Person or Polar Sky.
When it was approved.
Whether the approval was made before the period and still in force when it began.
When and how the approval ended in the period, if it did.
Where it was approved: the Polar Sky console or an AI assistant.
Which AI assistant was used, if any.

extract.title: Extract rows
extract.description: One row per grant, link, group member or group owner on each covered folder, as Polar Sky read it live at the extract's as-of time, in the stored file's order. The CSV is a rendering of the stored file, so its SHA-256 differs from the stored file's.

columns.description: The folder set the folder belongs to.
The folder that was read.
Grant, link, group member or group owner.
Who the grant is to: a person, a group or everyone.
The person or group's name.
The person or group's email address.
The account's login name in Microsoft 365.
What the grant allows, such as Read or Edit.
Whether the access comes from a parent folder or the drive.
The group a member row comes through.
For a link, who can open it.
For a link, what it allows, such as view or edit.
When a link expires, if it does.
When the access was given, when the provider records it.
Whether the grant reaches only the owners of a Microsoft 365 group.
Whether only some of a link's recipients are listed.
How many people a link was sent to.
The provider's id for the grant.
The provider's id for the person or group.
Polar Sky's id for the folder set.
The provider's id for the folder.
The provider's id for the drive or site.
When the folder was read.
